title: Why making a difference in psychology feels so good - DClinPsy - Clinical Psychology - Clinical Psychologist

sentences.en: Psychologists, what if you could earn money beyond trading your time for money?
sentences.zh: 心理学家们，如果你们能赚到除了出卖时间换取金钱以外的收入，会怎样？

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent, clinical psychologist, and I've been developing passive and recurring income streams since 2019.
sentences.zh: 我是临床心理学家 Marianne Trent 博士，自 2019 年以来，我一直在开发被动和经常性收入来源。

sentences.en: I have some exciting news.
sentences.zh: 我有一个令人兴奋的消息。

sentences.en: Sophie Foote's One-to-Many programme is now open for enrolment.
sentences.zh: Sophie Foote 的“一对多”项目现已开放报名。

sentences.en: It's designed to help you turn your expertise into scalable offers like courses, memberships and digital products.
sentences.zh: 它旨在帮助你将专业知识转化为可扩展的产品，如课程、会员资格和数字产品。

sentences.en: I completed the programme myself in 2022 and have since supported two cohorts of psychologists through their journeys too.
sentences.zh: 我自己在 2022 年完成了该项目，此后也支持了两批心理学家走过他们的职业旅程。

sentences.en: And if you join through my affiliate link, you'll receive Sophie's bonuses plus my own exclusive support package at no extra coSt.
sentences.zh: 如果你通过我的联盟链接加入，你将获得 Sophie 的奖励，以及我提供的独家支持套餐，无需额外费用。

sentences.en: That includes six months of WhatsApp support, four group masterminds, masterclasses, personalised guidance, a Fortnum and Mason treat, and a time-limited one-to-one coaching bonus.
sentences.zh: 这包括六个月的 WhatsApp 支持、四次小组智囊团会议、大师课、个性化指导、一份 Fortnum and Mason 的礼物，以及限时的一对一辅导奖励。

sentences.en: Enrolment closes on Monday the 16th of November at 10pm.
sentences.zh: 报名截止时间为 11 月 16 日星期一晚上 10 点。

sentences.en: Find out more via my bonus page linked in the description.
sentences.zh: 通过描述中链接的我的奖励页面了解更多信息。

sentences.en: And remember, you must purchase through my link to receive my bonuses.
sentences.zh: 请记住，你必须通过我的链接购买才能获得我的奖励。

sentences.en: I'm here if you have any questions.
sentences.zh: 如果你有任何问题，我随时为你解答。

sentences.en: Coming up in today's episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast,
sentences.zh: 在今天这一集的《有抱负的心理学家》播客中，

sentences.en: I am guiding you through two important steps that can help you think about weathering the storm on your journey to becoming whatever type of aspiring psychologist you fancy being.
sentences.zh: 我将引导你完成两个重要的步骤，帮助你思考如何在成为你心目中那种有抱负的心理学家的旅程中，经受住风雨的考验。

sentences.en: If you're looking to become a psychologist, then let this be your guide.
sentences.zh: 如果你正寻求成为一名心理学家，那么让这成为你的指南吧。

sentences.en: With this podcast at your side, you'll be on your way to being qualified.
sentences.zh: 有这个播客在身边，你离获得资格就不远了。

sentences.en: It's the Aspiring Psychologist podcast with Dr. Marianne Trent.
sentences.zh: 这是由 Marianne Trent 博士主持的《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: Hi, welcome along to the Aspiring Psychologist podcaSt.
sentences.zh: 嗨，欢迎收听《有抱负的心理学家》播客。

sentences.en: I'm Dr. Marianne Trent and I'm a qualified clinical psychologiSt.
sentences.zh: 我是 Marianne Trent 博士，我是一名合格的临床心理学家。

sentences.en: Let's have a look at what's in the lockout for today's Marianne summer soundbites.
sentences.zh: 让我们来看看今天的“Marianne 夏季短语”里有什么内容。

sentences.en: The first is something to remember and to bear in mind.
sentences.zh: 第一点是需要记住并放在心上的。

sentences.en: And that is that you are making a difference.
sentences.zh: 那就是你正在产生影响。

sentences.en: No matter what stage of your career you're at, whether you're working with the clients you want to serve, or whether you're working in some relevant experience role,
sentences.zh: 无论你处于职业生涯的哪个阶段，无论你是在为你想要服务的客户工作，还是在从事某种相关经验的角色，

sentences.en: or maybe even if you are still studying at undergraduate, I'm confident you're making a difference.
sentences.zh: 或者即使你还在读本科，我相信你都在产生影响。

sentences.en: The way you've been shaped, the way you've shaped, the way you've shaped, the way you've grown, the way you reflect, the way you communicate,
sentences.zh: 你被塑造的方式，你塑造事物的方式，你成长的方式，你反思的方式，你沟通的方式，

sentences.en: I'm confident that it's making a difference.
sentences.zh: 我相信这一切都在产生影响。

sentences.en: It might be that you're doing it through advocacy, through raising self-awareness in those that you work with, or even among your friends.
sentences.zh: 这可能是通过倡导，通过提高你所接触的人，甚至是你朋友们的自我意识来实现的。

sentences.en: You might be supporting those in your immediate circle.
sentences.zh: 你可能正在支持你身边的人。

sentences.en: I genuinely believe that your actions are bettering the lives of those around you, and hopefully of yourself too.
sentences.zh: 我真诚地相信，你的行动正在改善你周围人的生活，希望也能改善你自己的生活。

sentences.en: And honestly, you know, some people might say, why do you do what you do?
sentences.zh: 老实说，你知道，有些人可能会问，你为什么要从事现在的工作？

sentences.en: How do you do what you do?
sentences.zh: 你是怎么做到的？

sentences.en: How can you begin to do what you do?
sentences.zh: 你如何开始做你所做的事情？

sentences.en: It's just lovely to be able to help make people's lives better and to ease distress in people.
sentences.zh: 能够帮助改善人们的生活并减轻人们的痛苦，这真是太好了。

sentences.en: And, you know, for me, that is something that never gets a halt.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，对我来说，这是永远不会停滞的事情。

sentences.en: Helping people make sense of something which clearly and previously has felt nonsensical, or giving people like a roadmap to understand life and the way that their brain works,
sentences.zh: 帮助人们理解那些曾经看起来毫无意义的事情，或者为人们提供一张理解生活和大脑运作方式的路线图，

sentences.en: the way that they interact with those around them, and de-shaming the process can be really, really powerful.
sentences.zh: 以及他们与周围人的互动方式，并消除这个过程中的羞耻感，这真的非常非常有力量。

sentences.en: So, yeah, well done you.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，做得好。

sentences.en: You are making a difference, and everything you're learning about right now, even maybe some of the things we've said in the Summer Soundbites,
sentences.zh: 你正在产生影响，你现在所学的一切，甚至可能包括我们在“夏季短语”中提到的一些事情，

sentences.en: are going to continue to serve you and your clients well in future.
sentences.zh: 都将继续为你和你的客户提供良好的服务。

sentences.en: Let's take a moment to enjoy this little jingle, and I'll be back along very soon.
sentences.zh: 让我们花点时间欣赏一下这段小插曲，我很快就会回来。

sentences.en: Ah, just love those jingles.
sentences.zh: 啊，我就是喜欢这些插曲。

sentences.en: I do feel like perhaps we ought to have done a Summer Soundbites jingle, but, you know, make your own up.
sentences.zh: 我确实觉得也许我们应该制作一个“夏季短语”的插曲，但是，你知道，你自己编一个吧。

sentences.en: And come back to me if you've come up with a good one.
sentences.zh: 如果你想出了一个好的，回来告诉我。

sentences.en: I hope you found the first half useful and thought-provoking.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得前半部分有用且发人深省。

sentences.en: What did it evoke for you?
sentences.zh: 它引起了你什么样的共鸣？

sentences.en: Do come and let me know in my free Facebook group, The Aspiring Psychologist Community.
sentences.zh: 欢迎在我的免费 Facebook 群组“有抱负的心理学家社区”中告诉我。

sentences.en: So, at risk of going all-American with this episode, the second of my musings for today.
sentences.zh: 所以，冒着这一集变得过于美式的风险，这是我今天的第二个思考。

sentences.en: You've got to believe in yourself.
sentences.zh: 你必须相信自己。

sentences.en: You've got to have faith in yourself and your abilities.
sentences.zh: 你必须对自己和自己的能力有信心。

sentences.en: You know, I think there's a lot to be said in taking away the I can't to the I can's.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我认为把“我不能”变成“我能”有很多值得探讨的地方。

sentences.en: Make it I can.
sentences.zh: 把它变成“我能”。

sentences.en: Thinking about what excuses we might be setting for ourselves about why we're struggling to do something.
sentences.zh: 思考一下我们可能为自己找了什么借口，解释为什么我们在做某事时感到挣扎。

sentences.en: And thinking about how we can, indeed, do some of the things that might be on our goal liSt.
sentences.zh: 并思考我们如何确实能够完成目标清单上的一些事情。

sentences.en: Give yourself permission to apply for that job, to ask the questions in supervision, to put your hand up and ask a question in the MDT.
sentences.zh: 给自己许可去申请那份工作，在督导中提出问题，在多学科团队会议中举手提问。

sentences.en: Maybe even lead or host an MDT meeting yourself so that you can cultivate those skills.
sentences.zh: 甚至可以自己领导或主持多学科团队会议，这样你就可以培养这些技能。

sentences.en: You've got to trust in your capacity to learn, to adapt, and to make that meaningful difference in the lives of others.
sentences.zh: 你必须相信自己学习、适应并对他人的生活产生有意义影响的能力。

sentences.en: Believe in yourself.
sentences.zh: 相信自己。

sentences.en: You've got everything you need.
sentences.zh: 你拥有你需要的一切。

sentences.en: Now, you just need to optimise it.
sentences.zh: 现在，你只需要优化它。

sentences.en: Strengthen those muscles.
sentences.zh: 增强那些肌肉。

sentences.en: And some of those muscles might be your self-compassionate muscles.
sentences.zh: 其中一些肌肉可能是你的自我同情肌肉。

sentences.en: They might need thickening.
sentences.zh: 它们可能需要加强。

sentences.en: And that is something we do do very well in this Bioring Psychologist Membership too.
sentences.zh: 这也是我们在“有抱负的心理学家会员”中做得非常好的事情。

sentences.en: You might need to remind yourself of all of these things.
sentences.zh: 你可能需要提醒自己所有这些事情。

sentences.en: All of the things we've covered about self-worth in the summer series.
sentences.zh: 我们在夏季系列中涵盖的所有关于自我价值的内容。

sentences.en: Especially if you're having moments of self-doubt or self-criticism.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你正处于自我怀疑或自我批评的时刻。

sentences.en: I really hope that this journey of yours to becoming a qualified psychologist or even for that matter just working in mental health.
sentences.zh: 我真心希望你成为一名合格心理学家的旅程，或者仅仅是从事心理健康工作，

sentences.en: It's feeling fulfilling.
sentences.zh: 感觉是充实的。

sentences.en: It's feeling worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 感觉是有价值的。

sentences.en: You and your commitment and your passion and determination are incredible and admirable.
sentences.zh: 你以及你的承诺、热情和决心是令人难以置信和钦佩的。

sentences.en: Especially in this current culture of overstretched services and increased demand for mental health services and mental health professionals.
sentences.zh: 特别是在当前服务过度紧张、心理健康服务和专业人员需求增加的文化中。

sentences.en: I hope you've found this episode of Marianne Stuller Soundbites useful.
sentences.zh: 希望你觉得这一集“Marianne 夏季短语”很有用。

sentences.en: I will look forward to catching up with you for another episode of the Aspiring Psychologist podcast from Monday at 6am.
sentences.zh: 我期待在周一早上 6 点的下一集《有抱负的心理学家》播客中与你相见。

sentences.en: Take care.
sentences.zh: 保重。
